description: This file implements Bluetooth HCI socket communication, including functions for advertising, scanning, link key management, device discovery, and management commands via Bluez mgmt API. It defines classes and methods for interacting with Bluetooth hardware at a low level, handling events, and managing Bluetooth device states.

classes.name: HCISocket
classes.description: Represents a Bluetooth HCI socket, providing methods for advertising, scanning, and handling Bluetooth events.

classes.name: EIR
classes.description: Represents Extended Inquiry Response data, with methods to ingest and parse advertising data.

classes.name: ManagementSocket
classes.description: Handles Bluetooth management commands and events via Bluez mgmt API, including device discovery, pairing, and configuration.

methods.name: Advertising
methods.description: Enables or disables Bluetooth advertising with specified mode.

methods.name: Scan
methods.description: Performs Bluetooth device scanning with specified parameters.

methods.name: ReadStoredLinkKeys
methods.description: Reads stored link keys for a given Bluetooth address.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Aborts ongoing Bluetooth inquiry or scan.

methods.name: StateChange
methods.description: Handles socket state changes and sets appropriate filters.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes incoming Bluetooth HCI event data.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Virtual method to update internal state based on received HCI events.
